svg.text: BUILDING A NETWORKED SERVICE IN GO
From Zero to Capability — not just code, a complete mental model
"The scarce, high-value layer isn't the technology — it's your mind, the one holding the
continuous model of relationships, meaning, history, judgment, and what this means right now."
THE LEARNING MINDSET
You're not a consumer. You're a builder.

g.text: Build something you actually want to solve
Experience, curiosity, judgment — AI amplifies them
Build the smallest thing. Observe. Update your model
"I don't understand" is a hard stop
Research it. Build a tiny test. Then continue
From snippets to systems. From knowing to doing
Ask better questions. Collect the right information

svg.text: THE 5-PART INFORMATION MODEL
Apply this to every technical concept you encounter

g.text: Purpose — what problem does it solve?
Limits — what does it not solve?
Build and test it in action

svg.text: THE LEARNING LOOP
Repeat at every stage — this is how capability compounds
real world
Build
Observe
Improve
Model
THE 15 STAGES — THE JOURNEY
Each stage builds one new capability

g.text: Receive and answer — sockets, ports, bytes
See what the system is doing
Measure something, maintain state over time
Apply rules per client — independent state
Handle reality — goroutines, safe shared state
Apply pressure — characterize behavior under stress
Study failure — resilience and failure modes
Compare options — use data to guide decisions
Find the real bottleneck — CPU / memory
Scale beyond one machine — distributed systems

svg.text: THE SYSTEM — EXPLODED VIEW
Each layer adds a new layer of capability

g.text: Load Balancer / Reverse Proxy (optional, for scaling)
HTTP Server (Go net) — enforces policy, cross-cutting concerns
Middleware Layer — rate limiting, logging, auth
Application Handlers — your endpoints, business logic
In-Memory / Distributed State — client map, counters, tokens
Metrics & Monitoring — Prometheus, Grafana, debugging insight
Runtime / OS — Linux, Go runtime, the machine underneath
Hardware / Cloud — your machine or VPS

svg.text: THE MENTAL MODELS YOU'RE BUILDING
These are the real skills. The code is just the vehicle

g.text: See the whole. Understand how parts connect
Reason about many things happening at once
Move between detail and big picture
Track how things evolve over time

svg.text: THE BIG PICTURE
It's not about Go. It's about capability.
SAME HUMAN + BETTER MODELS + AMPLIFIED BY AI = REAL CAPABILITY
